title_zh: Social communication — 第26节可背诵讲义
body_en: When friends disagree, stay calm. Say what you feel without hard words. Offer a plan and ask what they need. If you make a mistake, say sorry early. Strong friendships grow from honest and kind talk.
body_zh: 朋友意见不合时保持冷静。说出感受，不要用伤人的话。提出一个计划，并问对方需要什么。若你错了，尽早说对不起。牢固的友谊来自诚实又友善的交流。
